observations: A manual hydraulic pallet jack (fork lift truck type) stands on a tiled porch/balcony.
Forks are painted yellow/orange, frame and handle are black, consistent with a standard hand pallet truck.
A small rectangular plate on the body appears to carry a capacity figure but it is mostly covered by the seller's watermark text 'PREYE DOUGLAS77', making the number unreadable.
Background shows unrelated items (a wheelchair, bags) indicating a storage/outdoor setting, not a dealer showroom.
No close-up of the hydraulic pump, release lever, or wheels/rollers is provided to judge mechanical condition.
Surface shows some paint wear/scuffing on the forks, consistent with used equipment.

claims.evidence: Capacity plate in photo 0 is present but obscured by watermark text; number not legible.
No stress test, load demonstration, or build-quality close-up provided.

claims.claim: Upgrade your warehouse, supermarket, or logistics...
claims.evidence: Marketing language, not a verifiable technical claim.

risks.risk: Actual load capacity may be lower than the claimed 2.5 Ton (plate unreadable).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the capacity data plate showing the kg/ton rating.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a lower/unspecified-capacity generic pallet jack

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump may leak or fail to lift/lower smoothly.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the jack being pumped up and lowered under a loaded pallet.

risks.risk: Wheels/rollers (steering and load wheels) may be worn, cracked, or missing bearings.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all wheels and casters.

risks.risk: Frame or fork may be bent/cracked from heavy use, not visible at this angle.
risks.proof: Side-on full-length photo and underside shot of the forks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as structurally unverified, worst case

proof_requests: Clear, unobstructed close-up of the capacity/data plate
Video of the pump handle being operated to raise and lower the forks
Close-up photos of all four wheels/rollers
Full side-profile photo of the forks and frame
response.reason: The item type is clear (manual hydraulic pallet jack), but the capacity rating that chiefly sets its price tier is hidden behind the seller's watermark and no functional or wheel/frame condition evidence is given, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without these shots.
